user.title: Add room
user.description: Create the room from an area to take over its thermostats and sensors, or enter a name yourself.

from_area.title: Room from area
from_area.description: The room takes the name of the area. Its thermostats and sensors are suggested on the next page.

data_description.area_id: The room's Easy TRV entities go into this area.

data_description.trvs: The ZHA thermostats that heat this room. A thermostat can belong to one room only.
data_description.temp_sensors: Order = priority; the first usable sensor is used.
data_description.humidity_sensors: Stored for later use; not evaluated yet.
data_description.window_contacts: Contacts that report an open window or door of this room. They may come from another area, for example the kitchen when it is joined to the living room. While one of them is open, the room's heating is switched off. Optional.

data_description.area_id: The room's Easy TRV entities go into this area.
data_description.trvs: The ZHA thermostats that heat this room. A thermostat can belong to one room only.
data_description.temp_sensors: Order = priority; the first usable sensor is used.
data_description.humidity_sensors: Stored for later use; not evaluated yet.
data_description.window_contacts: Contacts that report an open window or door of this room. They may come from another area, for example the kitchen when it is joined to the living room. While one of them is open, the room's heating is switched off. Optional.

settings.title: Room settings
settings.description: Every setting follows the integration options (Global) unless you set it for this room. A number field left empty also means Global.

data.window_open_delay_seconds: Delay before a window counts as open (seconds, 0 = immediately)
data.window_warn_colder: Warn only when it is colder outside
data.reset_settings: Reset all settings of this room to Global

data_description.profile: Auto picks the first profile that matches all thermostats of the room. Global is currently {global_profile}.
data_description.window_detection: Switches the thermostat's own open-window detection on or off. It triggers when the temperature falls by about 1.5 K within 4.5 minutes and ends the heating pause after 30 minutes at the latest. It has nothing to do with window contacts in Home Assistant. Global is currently {global_window_detection}.
data_description.hysteresis: Temperature hysteresis of the thermostats. It is ignored while the adaptive mode is on. Global is currently {global_hysteresis}.
data_description.adaptive_mode: The thermostat adapts to the room itself. While it is on, the hysteresis is ignored. Needs firmware 1.4.4 or newer. Global is currently {global_adaptive_mode}.
data_description.frost_temperature: The temperature the thermostat keeps as frost protection. 4.0 to 16.0 °C. Global is currently {global_frost_temperature}.
data_description.hide_thermostat_entities: Hides the climate entity of the TRVs and the settings that Easy TRV controls. They keep working but no longer appear on automatic dashboards. Turning this off shows them again. Global is currently {global_hide_thermostat_entities}.
data_description.refresh_minutes: How often the current room temperature is written to the thermostats again, even if it has not changed. 1 to 120 minutes. Global is currently {global_refresh_minutes}.
data_description.verify_delay_seconds: How long to wait after a write before the value is read back from the thermostat to verify it. 2 to 60 seconds. Global is currently {global_verify_delay_seconds}.
data_description.max_attempts: How often a failed write is tried before the thermostat is reported as not responding. 1 to 10. Global is currently {global_max_attempts}.
data_description.min_delta_kelvin: A new room temperature is only written when it differs from the last written value by at least this much. 0.0 to 1.0 K. Global is currently {global_min_delta_kelvin}.
data_description.sensor_timeout_minutes: A temperature sensor that has not reported for this long is ignored. 0 switches the timeout off, otherwise 10 to 1440 minutes. Global is currently {global_sensor_timeout_minutes}.
data_description.setpoint_range: Automatic reads, when the room is set up, the minimum and maximum target temperature the thermostats show in Home Assistant (with several, the narrowest common range, else the range of the profile). Manual takes the minimum and maximum below. Global is currently {global_setpoint_range}.
data_description.setpoint_min: The lowest target temperature the room accepts. 4.0 to 35.0 °C and below the maximum. Only used with the setpoint range Manual. Global is currently {global_setpoint_min}.
data_description.setpoint_max: The highest target temperature the room accepts. 4.0 to 35.0 °C and above the minimum. Only used with the setpoint range Manual. Global is currently {global_setpoint_max}.
data_description.window_open_delay_seconds: How long a window contact must stay open before the window counts as open and the heating is switched off. Airing for a moment switches nothing off. 0 = immediately, otherwise 1 to 600 seconds. Global is currently {global_window_open_delay_seconds}.
data_description.window_warn_minutes: After how many minutes an open window raises a Repairs issue (0 = never). The heating stays off until the window is closed. 0 to 1440 minutes. Global is currently {global_window_warn_minutes}.
data_description.window_warn_colder: The open-window warning is raised only while the outdoor temperature is below the room temperature. If it gets colder later, it is raised then. Needs the outdoor temperature sensor; with the outdoor temperature unknown, it warns. The heating is switched off while the window is open either way. Global is currently {global_window_warn_colder}.
data_description.window_check_minutes: After how many minutes with an open window the room must have cooled by at least the amount set in "Cooling expected by the check (K)", otherwise a hint is raised that the contact may be stuck (0 = off). 0 to 240 minutes. Global is currently {global_window_check_minutes}.
data_description.window_check_drop_kelvin: How far the room temperature must have fallen since the window was opened for the contact to count as plausible. 0.1 to 3.0 K. Global is currently {global_window_check_drop_kelvin}.
data_description.outdoor_cutoff: Global follows the outdoor cut-off temperature of the integration options (currently {global_outdoor_cutoff_celsius}), unless you enter a temperature of your own below. Off never switches this room off because of the outdoor temperature.
data_description.outdoor_cutoff_celsius: The room switches off when the outdoor temperature reaches this value and back on 0.5 K below it. Needs an outdoor sensor in the integration options. -10.0 to 30.0 °C. Empty = Global, currently {global_outdoor_cutoff_celsius}.
data_description.presence: Global takes the presence entity of the integration options (currently {global_presence_entity}). None ignores presence for this room. Own takes the entity below.
data_description.presence_entity: Only with presence Own: this room's entity (person, device tracker, zone, group, binary sensor or input boolean).
data_description.presence_unknown: How an unknown or unavailable state of the entity counts. Global is currently {global_presence_unknown}.
data_description.away_action: Lower takes the target down by the setback, never below the frost protection temperature. Off switches the thermostats off like an open window. Global is currently {global_away_action}.
data_description.away_setback_kelvin: How far the target goes down while away. 0.5 to 10 K. Global is currently {global_away_setback_kelvin}.
data_description.statistics: Control deviation, heating time, windows and Zigbee counters as long-term statistics. Hidden collects without filling lists and dashboards. Off creates no statistics sensors and removes existing ones. Global is currently {global_statistics}.
data_description.reset_settings: On submit every setting of this room follows the global options again and the values above are ignored. Where the room's presence comes from stays.

trv_unreachable.title: Thermostat {thermostat} in {room} is not responding

trv_firmware.title: Thermostat {thermostat} in {room} lacks a firmware feature
trv_firmware.description:
Easy TRV cannot use "{setting}" on {thermostat} in {room}. Required firmware: {required}. Installed firmware: {current}.

Easy TRV skips this setting for this thermostat and keeps controlling it otherwise. Update the thermostat's firmware (for example through the ZHA over-the-air update) to enable it. Alternatively set this setting to 'leave as set in the thermostat' or off for this room.

zha_api_incompatible.title: Easy TRV cannot use the Zigbee integration
zha_api_incompatible.description:
Easy TRV could not talk to the installed ZHA integration: {error}

If ZHA has just been (re)loaded, Easy TRV retries on its own and this issue disappears once it works. After a Home Assistant update that keeps failing, check for a newer Easy TRV version.

profile_invalid.title: Thermostat profile {file} is invalid
profile_invalid.description:
The profile file {file} in the easy_trv/profiles folder of your configuration directory was skipped: {error}

Fix or remove the file and reload the Easy TRV integration. This issue disappears when the file loads cleanly.

room_invalid.title: Room {room} could not be set up
room_invalid.description:
Easy TRV skipped the room {room}: {error}

The other rooms keep running. Edit the room, or fix what it depends on (the thermostat in ZHA, a profile file), and reload the Easy TRV integration. This issue disappears when the room sets up cleanly.

settings_migrated.title: Thermostat settings changed by the update
settings_migrated.description:
These rooms had "Leave unchanged" for the hysteresis: {rooms}.

They now follow the global hysteresis ({hysteresis}). While the adaptive mode is on, the thermostat manages the hysteresis itself and none is written, on thermostats with firmware 1.4.4 or newer. Check the global setting in the Easy TRV options, or set a hysteresis in the room itself.

You can dismiss this notice.

window_open_long.title: Window open in {room} for {minutes} minutes
window_open_long.description:
The window in {room} has been open for {minutes} minutes and all its thermostats stay off, those on their own schedule included.

Close the window, or check the window contact if it is already closed. The heating returns by itself when the contact reports closed; this issue disappears then. Thermostats that were on their schedule stay off afterwards until you switch them back in ZHA.

window_contact_suspect.title: The window contact in {room} reports open, but the room is not cooling
window_contact_suspect.description:
The window contact in {room} has reported open for {minutes} minutes, yet the room temperature has not fallen by at least {drop} K since it opened.

Check whether the contact is stuck or its battery is flat. Easy TRV keeps the thermostats off while the contact reports open; this issue disappears when it reports closed.

window_contact_unavailable.title: Window contact in {room} is not reachable
window_contact_unavailable.description: For at least 10 minutes a window contact in {room} has not reported a state. Currently silent: {contacts}. Easy TRV treats such a contact as it was last: one last seen closed, or never seen, counts as closed, so opening that window does not switch the heating off. One last seen open keeps the heating off until it reports again. Check the contact's battery and radio connection.

schedule_thermostat_off.title: {thermostat} in {room} stays off after the window was closed
schedule_thermostat_off.description:
Easy TRV switched {thermostat} in {room} off while the window was open (or it was too warm outside). The thermostat was running its own weekly schedule. Easy TRV does not restore schedules and never writes "auto", so it stays off.

Switch it back to its schedule in ZHA. This issue disappears as soon as the thermostat reports auto or heat again.

init.title: Easy TRV settings
init.description: These settings apply to all rooms. Each room can override them. Number fields left empty use the built-in default.

writes.name: Writes
writes.description: How often and how carefully the room temperature is written to the thermostats.

data_description.refresh_minutes: How often the current room temperature is written to the thermostats again, even if it has not changed. 1 to 120 minutes. Empty = {default_refresh_minutes}.
data_description.verify_delay_seconds: How long to wait after a write before the value is read back from the thermostat to verify it. 2 to 60 seconds. Empty = {default_verify_delay_seconds}.
data_description.max_attempts: How often a failed write is tried before the thermostat is reported as not responding. 1 to 10. Empty = {default_max_attempts}.
data_description.min_delta_kelvin: A new room temperature is only written when it differs from the last written value by at least this much. 0.0 to 1.0 K. Empty = {default_min_delta_kelvin}.
data_description.sensor_timeout_minutes: A temperature sensor that has not reported for this long is ignored. 0 switches the timeout off, otherwise 10 to 1440 minutes. Empty = {default_sensor_timeout_minutes}.

thermostat.name: Thermostat settings
thermostat.description: These settings concern the thermostats. All of them except hiding are written to the thermostats.

data_description.window_detection: Switches the thermostat's own open-window detection on or off. It triggers when the temperature falls by about 1.5 K within 4.5 minutes and ends the heating pause after 30 minutes at the latest. It has nothing to do with window contacts in Home Assistant.
data_description.hysteresis: Temperature hysteresis of the thermostats. It is ignored while the adaptive mode is on.
data_description.adaptive_mode: The thermostat adapts to the room itself. While it is on, the hysteresis is ignored. Needs firmware 1.4.4 or newer.
data_description.frost_temperature: The temperature the thermostat keeps as frost protection. 4.0 to 16.0 °C. Empty = {default_frost_temperature}.
data_description.hide_thermostat_entities: Hides the climate entity of the TRVs and the settings that Easy TRV controls. They keep working but no longer appear on automatic dashboards. Turning this off shows them again.

room_thermostat.name: Room thermostat
room_thermostat.description: The limits of the target temperature that can be set on a room.

data_description.setpoint_range: Automatic reads, when the room is set up, the minimum and maximum target temperature the thermostats show in Home Assistant (with several, the narrowest common range, else the range of the profile). Manual takes the minimum and maximum below.
data_description.setpoint_min: The lowest target temperature a room accepts. 4.0 to 35.0 °C and below the maximum. Only used with the setpoint range Manual. Empty = {default_setpoint_min}.
data_description.setpoint_max: The highest target temperature a room accepts. 4.0 to 35.0 °C and above the minimum. Only used with the setpoint range Manual. Empty = {default_setpoint_max}.

windows_outdoor.name: Windows and outdoor
windows_outdoor.description: What happens when a window is open for long and when it is warm outside. Number fields left empty use the built-in default.

data.window_open_delay_seconds: Delay before a window counts as open (seconds, 0 = immediately)
data.window_warn_colder: Warn only when it is colder outside

data_description.window_open_delay_seconds: How long a window contact must stay open before the window counts as open and the heating is switched off. Airing for a moment switches nothing off. 0 = immediately, otherwise 1 to 600 seconds. Empty = {default_window_open_delay_seconds}.
data_description.window_warn_minutes: After how many minutes an open window raises a Repairs issue (0 = never). The heating stays off until the window is closed. 0 to 1440 minutes. Empty = {default_window_warn_minutes}.
data_description.window_warn_colder: The open-window warning is raised only while the outdoor temperature is below the room temperature. If it gets colder later, it is raised then. Needs the outdoor temperature sensor; with the outdoor temperature unknown, it warns. The heating is switched off while the window is open either way.
data_description.window_check_minutes: After how many minutes with an open window the room must have cooled by at least the amount set in "Cooling expected by the check (K)", otherwise a hint is raised that the contact may be stuck (0 = off). 0 to 240 minutes. Empty = {default_window_check_minutes}.
data_description.window_check_drop_kelvin: How far the room temperature must have fallen since the window was opened for the contact to count as plausible. 0.1 to 3.0 K. Empty = {default_window_check_drop_kelvin}.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: The temperature sensor the outdoor cut-off reads. Without it the cut-off does nothing.
data_description.outdoor_cutoff_celsius: The room switches off when the outdoor temperature reaches this value and back on 0.5 K below it. A room can turn this off for itself. -10.0 to 30.0 °C. Empty = {default_outdoor_cutoff_celsius}.

presence.name: Presence
presence.description: What a room does while nobody is home. Presence comes from an entity you choose here for all rooms; a room can use its own or none.

data_description.presence_entity: A person, a device tracker, a zone (for example zone.home), a group, a binary sensor or an input boolean. Home means: person or tracker home, zone with at least one person, group home or on, switch or sensor on. Empty = no presence.
data_description.presence_unknown: How an unknown or unavailable state of the entity counts. Default: away.
data_description.away_action: Lower takes the target down by the setback, never below the frost protection temperature. Off switches the thermostats off like an open window. A new target while away holds until someone is home.
data_description.away_setback_kelvin: How far the target goes down while away. 0.5 to 10 K. Empty = {default_away_setback_kelvin}.

statistics.name: Statistics
statistics.description: What Easy TRV records about each room as long-term statistics.

data_description.statistics: Control deviation, heating time, windows and Zigbee counters as long-term statistics. Hidden collects without filling lists and dashboards. Off creates no statistics sensors and removes existing ones.

data.reset_settings: Reset all settings to their defaults

data_description.reset_settings: On submit every setting goes back to its built-in default and the values above are ignored. The outdoor temperature sensor and the presence entity stay.
